subject.title: feat(google-meet): retain the full caption transcript per session (#103387)

question: Should Google Meet expose this new gateway/tool/CLI transcript API as a bounded, runtime-memory-only session contract that is lost on gateway restart?
rationale: The code can be repaired mechanically, but accepting three new public surfaces, a fixed 2,000-line retention policy, and restart-limited lifetime requires owner intent that is not present in the issue or PR discussion.

options.title: Accept the bounded runtime API
options.body: Approve the new transcript surfaces after cursor validation, eviction/lifetime docs, focused tests, and live Meet proof are complete.

options.title: Narrow the public surface
options.body: Keep accumulation internal and expose it through fewer existing Google Meet status or export surfaces instead of adding three parallel entry points.

options.title: Defer transcript retention
options.body: Close or pause the PR until persistent transcript ownership and lifecycle are designed together.

recommendation.title: Accept the bounded runtime API
recommendation.body: Approve the new transcript surfaces after cursor validation, eviction/lifetime docs, focused tests, and live Meet proof are complete.

likelyOwner.reason: The history shows the strongest ownership signal for the plugin, caption observer, runtime, and public Google Meet surfaces affected by this choice.
